pinterest.title: Lake Como Villa Wedding, Exclusive Use: 8 Villas You Can Book Whole
pinterest.description: Planning a Lake Como villa wedding with exclusive use? Exclusive use means the house, gardens, dock and bedrooms are yours alone. We compare eight Lake Como villas whose owners or operators confirm whole-property booking, shore by shore: who sleeps on site, how many you can seat, which can host a legal civil ceremony, and the house rules to get in writing before you commit.

pinterest.title: Lake Como Wedding Villas With Accommodation: How Many Sleep On Site
pinterest.description: Beds, not dinner seats, are the limit at a Lake Como villa wedding. Where they publish figures, these villas seat about 70 to 200 for dinner but sleep 12 to about 40. Villa Pliniana in Torno seats up to 200 in its ballrooms and sleeps the most on our list. Plan the villa for your families and a nearby hotel room block for everyone else.

pinterest.title: Lake Como Villa Wedding Logistics: Private Docks, Boats and Airports
pinterest.description: All eight exclusive-use villas in our Lake Como guide have a private dock, pier, jetty or pontoon, so guests can arrive from the water. Charter private boats for guest shuttles rather than relying on the public ferry, with a road transfer as backup. Plus the four main airports for Lake Como and how to plan transfers for a destination wedding in Italy.

slides: Not every famous Lake Como villa can be booked for your wedding alone. Here are 8 that can.
Exclusive use means the whole property is yours: house, gardens, dock and bedrooms, closed to everyone but your guests.
Beds are the real limit. These villas seat about 70 to 200 for dinner but sleep 12 to about 40. Most guest lists also need a nearby room block.
Legal on site is the exception. Villa Làrio and Relais Villa Vittoria state they can host a civil ceremony. Elsewhere, plan a symbolic ceremony at the villa and the legal one at a town hall.
Read the house rules. At Relais Villa Vittoria, weddings of more than 30 guests must take the whole villa and every room. Villa Aura del Lago sets a three-night minimum for weddings.
Arrive by water. All eight villas have a private dock, pier, jetty or pontoon. Charter private boats for guests rather than relying on the public ferry.
Minimum nights, music curfews and rain plans are rarely published. Get them in writing for your dates.
Have two or three villas in mind? Tell us your date and guest count, and a Wedded Advisor will check your shortlist. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Which Lake Como villas can you book for an exclusive-use wedding?

Exclusive use means the whole property is yours: house, gardens, dock and bedrooms. Not every famous name on the lake offers it. Some are hotels that host weddings in their function rooms; some are heritage gardens with no bedrooms.

Our new guide compares eight villas whose owners or operators confirm exclusive use on their own websites, from Villa Balbiano in Ossuccio to Villa Lario Resort in Mandello del Lario. For each one: who sleeps on site, how many you can seat, the ceremony options and what to ask before you commit.

The short version: plan the villa for your families, hold a hotel room block nearby for everyone else, and get the minimum stay, curfew and rain plan in writing.

Comparing villas for your own Lake Como wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the villas you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you check your shortlist. Full guide at the link in our bio.
